availability.fallback: Unavailable cell retains exact local67 score and eligibility; do not shrink pool or renormalize. A missing required SPY input makes all direct-stock feature cells unavailable at that signal. No post hoc breadth threshold.
availability.fatal: Conflicting axes, duplicated/misaligned identity, future inputs or unexpected arithmetic failures halt the stage instead of becoming discretionary missing values.
availability.one_mask: All three arms use exactly the same required prices, valid old fit and finite delay/fold outputs. No arm may retain a cell unavailable to another.

baseline_source.preserved: All27 DATA arrays, originalMETA/identities/eligibility, original local67 ordered choices and scores.

before_plan_amendments.cause: Synthetic-only local BLAS floating-point flag contamination after QR/solve: finite ordinary inputs raised divide-by-zero in subsequent matmul.
before_plan_amendments.repair: All producer contractions use explicit np.einsum optimize=False; finite/rank/residual checks retained. Reference test likewise avoids contaminated matmul. No threshold changes, actual data, fits or returns.

clock.axis: t is an exact position on the bound official session axis, not a calendar day or compressed nonmissing row.
clock.execution_limit: Signal close t is known only at that close; same-close execution remains the inherited idealized research convention. Identical-order next-open stress is required.
clock.predictors: For every response d consume contemporaneous m_d and each m_d-j, j=1..5. Earliest predictor return is t-298, requiring SPY price t-299.
clock.recent_spy_returns: Exactly m_t-4..m_t. Prices in the gap t-41..t-6 are unused by this new feature; baseline retains its own unchanged windows.
clock.returns: r_i,d=log(P_i,d/P_i,d-1); m_d=log(P_SPY,d/P_SPY,d-1), using stable positive-price log ratios.

estimator.arithmetic_policy: Constant market or exactly zero stock residual scale is unavailable. Unexpected nonfinite arithmetic, solver failure or rank loss of nonconstant B stops preparation; never silently switch estimator. Freeze implementation tolerances in the later reviewed DESIGN before any actual feature computation.
estimator.fixed_model: All five lag coefficients remain, no sign constraints, lag selection, online update, monthly future-return labels or second predictive Ridge. Ridge may accept collinear lag columns without dropping them.
estimator.normalization: mu=mean(m_d) and s=sqrt(mean((m_d-mu)^2)) on the252 contemporaneous fit returns. Require finite s>0. Define z_d=(m_d-mu)/s for ALL lag and recent inputs using only this old mu,s.
estimator.objective: min_theta ||v-Q theta||_2^2 + 10||theta||_2^2. This is SUM loss, not mean loss. theta solves (Q.T Q+10I5)theta=Q.T v without explicit matrix inversion.
estimator.partialling: Using fixed stable two-column OLS/QR, let v=(I-P_B)y and Q=(I-P_B)Z. Intercept and contemporaneous market exposure are unpenalized nuisance terms.
estimator.residual_scale: Refit gamma=OLS(B,y-Z theta); eps=y-B gamma-Z theta; sigma=sqrt(mean(eps^2)) on exactly252 fit rows. Require finite sigma>0. sigma is an in-sample scale proxy, not forecast uncertainty.

failure_risks: Lagged association need not be causal and may reflect asynchronous trading or omitted common drivers.
Liquid constituents may adjust too quickly; valid outcome can be nearzero scores and no changed orders.
The fit ends42sessions earlier and may be stale; not permission to retune after outcomes.
A one-week effect may reverse or dilute over the full fixed month.
Ridge/scale quality is not predictive evidence; extreme finite tanh saturation is bounded but not a probability.
More than127 reused research rounds create selection risk; no70percent return claim follows from this proposal.

fixed_framework.baseline: Exact frozen incumbent_local67, regardless of round128 result; do not promote a newer baseline from that outcome.
fixed_framework.core: Original skip42 long-momentum formula and .50/.52 weights unchanged.
fixed_framework.feature_population: Original direct-stock candidates only. The17 ETFs retain exact baseline score and eligibility; they are not removed from the selectable pool.
fixed_framework.holdings: Monthly EW3, two half positions when exactly2 eligible, fewer than2 cash; fixed units inside month. No leverage, shorting, intramonth exits, ticker exceptions or month exceptions.
fixed_framework.sources: Existing bound stock/SPY adjusted closes and official XNYS axis only. No downloads, provider substitutions, forward fill or interpolation. Existing historical-universe and vendor-vintage limits remain.
fixed_framework.universe: Same122 original signal dates, original symbol order and original32 stocks+17 ETFs, eligibility, annual models, local-quarter correction and episode policy.

design.hypothesis: Among stocks already eligible under fixed local67, a positive estimated remaining five-session response to market moves already observed at the signal close may improve the original third-seat boundary choice. This is delayed price co-movement, not measured news diffusion or causal information arrival. It may have no useful predictive effect.

numerical_implementation.exact_constant_response: If all 252 supplied y values are exactly equal, analytic theta=zeros(5), gamma=[y0,0], sigma=0; unavailable exact-zero residual. No near-equality test.
numerical_implementation.market_resolution: exact s==0 gives zero_training_market_scale; 0<s<=64*eps*RMS(m_current252) gives numerically_unresolved_market_scale
numerical_implementation.normal_equation_test: max(abs(A theta-b)) <= 1e-11*(norm_inf(A)*norm_inf(theta)+norm_inf(b)); exact zero RHS requires exact zero residual
numerical_implementation.projection: Reduced NumPy QR of B=[1,z_current]; two-column triangular solve for gamma. All contractions use np.einsum(optimize=False), never BLAS matmul.
numerical_implementation.residual_resolution: exact sigma==0 gives zero_training_stock_residual_scale; 0<sigma<=64*eps*max(RMS(y),RMS(y_hat)) gives numerically_unresolved_residual_scale
numerical_implementation.ridge: NumPy solve of the 5x5 SPD sum-loss normal equations plus 10*I; all five columns retained; one thread.
numerical_implementation.rms: math.hypot over values / sqrt(n), avoiding squared-value underflow/overflow
numerical_implementation.scale_invariance: No absolute 1.0 floor. Never snap small theta/F/H to zero. Exact F==0 produces literal H=0 and bypasses score writes.
numerical_implementation.training_center: origin + fsum(values-origin)/252; centered residual differences computed before adding origin
numerical_implementation.unexpected_nonfinite: fatal at every intermediate array/result; solver failures propagate; no alternative fit or estimator

placement.bound: abs(delta)<=.0125 plus frozen floating tolerance. Top2 and all outside-cohort cells are byte-identical.
placement.choice: Third seat maximizes corrected post-episode score inside the original cohort; same symbol tie-break. Final fixedtop2+third sorted as existing adapter. Fewer than3 eligible, all unavailable, or allzero corrections returns original choices exactly.
placement.cohort: Use actual unmodified local67 pre-episode score to lock original eligible top2 and originalrank3..5 with gap<=.02 from originalrank3; original symbol tie-break.
placement.episode: Call original episode selector exactly once with original support/effects. Add correction only to finite nonzero-H cells in that fixed third-seat cohort afterward. No new global ranking, cohort change or second episode call.
placement.reference: Exact semantics of outputs/monthly_boundary_preserve70/placement.py, to be byte-bound if implemented.
placement.support: S=(original_baseline-original_weighted_core)/(1-core_weight); delta=.025*(clip(S+H,-.5,.5)-S). Replaces .025 of original support; original core and all model/episode allocations stay intact.

scores.folded_control: G_i=sum_{k=0..4}w_i,k=sum_{j=1..5}j*theta_i,j; F_fold=G_i*mean(z_t,z_t-1,z_t-2,z_t-3,z_t-4). Same fitted coefficients, old normalization, residual scale and input mask; no separate fit.
scores.folded_invariants: Fold preserves constant-shock total gain and recent mean but discards recent-shock placement. Both formulas coincide for a constant recent z path. Fold is invariant to permutation of the recent five values; delay generally is not.
scores.hand: H_A=.5*tanh(F_A/(sigma*sqrt(5))) for A=delay,fold. H_zero=0 on common available cells. No cross-sectional ranking or learned scaling. sqrt(5) is a fixed units convention, not proof of independent errors or a confidence interval.
scores.interpretation: Only the portion of fitted next-five-session response attributable to shocks already observed by t. Unknown future market innovations are set to their old-window mean (z=0); intercept and contemporaneous exposure forecasts are excluded. Not a full monthly expected-return forecast.
scores.observed_zero: Zero coefficients, cancellations or zero F are valid zero observations. Explicitly bypass score writes when H or delta equals0; do not convert zeros into missing or tie ranks.
scores.remaining_response: F_delay(i,t)=sum_{h=1..5} sum_{j=h..5} theta_i,j*z_(t+h-j). All referenced z dates are<=t. Equivalent: sum_{k=0..4} w_i,k*z_(t-k), w_i,k=sum_{j=k+1..5}theta_i,j.

selection_schema.guards_against: two booleans, each strict training CAGR AND every risk/subperiod guard; undefined numeric metrics yield False

source_provenance.calendar: Bound original calendar provenance with explicit XNYS closures. Price index must equal complete official sessions through last signal.

source_provenance.raw_files: Exactly64 existing raw source hash entries from frozen local67 PLAN; verify before prepare and compare loader manifest; no new provider or network

tolerances.discrete: Exact axes, identity, reasons, masks, choices, immutable arrays and source hashes. Zero-correction scores/orders exactly baseline.
